---
title: "Apps to work with HMT data sets"
---


Since these apps are self-contained HTML pages, you can download them and use them on your own computer, or follow the links below to use the current version installed on github pages.


::: {.callout-note}
## A note on version numbers
Each app displays an individual version number. Github release numbers refer to packaged releases of the *entire* repository. For details on the contents of both github releases and individual app versions, see the [release notes](https://github.com/neelsmith/hmt-apps/blob/main/releases.md).

:::

## Manuscript facsimiles

1. [Codex facsimiles](../codices.html): browse a facsimile of a codex, see indexed images, and overlay texts where HMT editions exist.
1. [Interwoven text/image](../iliad-scholia-text.html): 

## Browsing images

1. [Browse images](../images.html) from all HMT image collections.


## Browsing texts

1. [*Iliad* + *scholia* reader](../iliad-scholia.html): select passage of the *Iliad* and view any *scholia* on the selected lines
1. [Cross-manuscript *scholia* reader](../all-scholia.html): select passage of the *Iliad* in a given version, and view passage together with *scholia* from *all* edited versions
1. [Interwoven diplomatic/normalized reader](../editorial.html): read *Iliad* and *scholia* texts in diplomatic transcription with editorial normalizations in parentheses.

## Searching text contents

1. [Simple text search](../stringsearch.html): search text of *Iliad* and *scholia* for strings of text.
1. [Count results of string search](../stringcounter.html): search text of *Iliad* and *scholia* for strings of text, tabulate frequencies, optionally explore individual passages.
1. [Lemmatized text search](../lemmatizedsearch.html): search text of *Iliad* and *scholia* for text identified by lemma, optionally explore individual passages. Lemmatizations dervied using Patrick Burns' [LatinCy language models](https://latincy.github.io/latincy-book/).
1. [Find texts by proper names](../propernames.html): find occurrences of personal, geographic and ethnic names and see their text in context.
